text:
[issue by PNaClNH3]
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1 (LTS)

### Mod Loader

Forge

### Mod Version

balm-forge-1.20.1-7.3.11-all

### Describe the Issue

I did not crash once before the update.   After the update today, when I hung up the phone, I suddenly crashed inexplicably and reported an error caused by KleeSlabs and Balm.   I think the BUG was caused by the update of Balm，Error report shows thread: thread rendering
